ValidationRule.description: This validation rule prevent the user editing on the Closed record
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c != true, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Data Migration', ISPICKVAL(Status, 'ReOpened'), ( NSP_Date_Closed__c < ( TODAY()-91)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can't Reopen the Case that Closed 90 days ago
